[![Archived from CRAN](https://img.shields.io/badge/CRAN-archived-lightgrey.svg)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=jpndistrict) [![Development version on r-universe](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Furibo.r-universe.dev%2Fapi%2Fpackages%2Fjpndistrict&query=%24.Version&label=r-universe)](https://uribo.r-universe.dev/jpndistrict)

Builds maps of Japanese administrative areas and government offices from the National Land Numerical Information. Archived from CRAN in 2020; the source remains on [GitHub](https://github.com/uribo/jpndistrict); documentation at [uribo.github.io/jpndistrict](https://uribo.github.io/jpndistrict/).
